pkgmetadata.longdescription: The FreedomNAS web interface: a FastAPI backend over freedomnas-core and a dependency-free Jinja2 frontend with three UI levels. Includes the first-run wizard that configures a freshly installed or freshly flashed system.

use.flag: Start the WebUI at boot through a cron @reboot hook — the init-agnostic path FreedomNAS uses on every edition
Install an OpenRC service instead of the cron hook
